identification: Small framed oil on board of tall forest trees with loose impasto, wide off-white linen mount and grey/gilt frame, signed lower left 'Colin Parker '65' (photo reads COLIN PARKER '65). Probably Colin (Ross) Parker, b.1941, Australian landscape painter mostly seen selling Western NSW and outback scenes; a 1965 date would make him about 24, so artist identity and Tasmanian connection unconfirmed. A second Colin Parker oil (An Old Peppercorn) is in the same Gowans sale, suggesting a single vendor group.
